changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`

- names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Every one of the six is read by `normalizeSeries` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts:242-255`) and does real work in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — `label` names the legend entry, `variant === 'comparison'` selects the muted overlay, `opacity` / `dashArray` set stroke and fill, `stack` becomes Recharts' `stackId`, `yAxis` binds the secondary axis. Any consumer of the parse output — `objectui check` / `objectui validate` via `safeValidateSchema`, a JSON schema derived from the mirror, or any pipeline that keeps `parse()`'s result — lost them outright.

### `.changeset/7694-chart-series-chart-type-alias-refusal.md`

- names `normalizeChartSchema.ts` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` — edited by this change

  > `chartType` is the renderer's INTERNAL spelling of `type`: the first limb of `normalizeSeries`' `str(raw.chartType) ?? str(raw.type)` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts`), written by the internal-shape producers that hand `dataKey`-shaped arrays straight to `ChartRenderer` (`ObjectChart`, `DatasetWidget`; `core/utils/chart-presentation` translates authored `type` *into* it) and by nothing an author writes. Re-measured at implementation time, series-level, with lit controls (`dataKey` / `name` / `type` / `color`): docs 0, fixtures 0, designer inputs 0 (the `chart` registration's `series` is one `code` input), src literals 0, tests 9 — every one an internal-shape array that never meets this mirror. Limb ablation over 304 files / 5817 tests: deleting `str(raw.chartType) ??` left all green; deleting the `?? str(raw.type)` sibling went 2 red.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `7baede374` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1516 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2102 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36166627057)

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2fd09e70848da932f28bbc43d689f78da5d0c40a`

Read: card objectui#10654 (body, comments 5834536782 · 5835132719 · 5835682793; the os-dev-report 5836589916 was not used as evidence), the folded card objectui#10655 and its fold comment 5835169621, PR #10686 body and file list, the diff at merge-base `7baede3745904d929d4afd80bcd5e2314b466072` against the head, the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` (`ChartAxisSchema.position: z.enum(['left','right','top','bottom']).optional()`, `ChartSeries.yAxis: z.enum(['left','right']).default('left')`, `ChartConfig.yAxis: z.array(ChartAxisSchema).optional()`), objectui `AGENTS.md` (版本号策略 and the changeset rule at :168-169) and `.changeset/config.json`. Five files: `.changeset/10654-yaxis-position-honoured.md` (+48), `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` (+1/-1), `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (+252/-70), `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.yAxisPosition-10654.test.tsx` (+411, new), `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` (+122/-4). No existing test file is edited or deleted. I did not run the suite (read-only via git; the shared checkout carries no `node_modules`); CI at the head is the instrument for the pins.

### ① Derived judgments

Triage `5835132719` binds: 「follow PR objectui#10647's shape for `xAxis.position`. Honour the sides a y axis can take, refuse any other side with a visible note naming `yAxis[N].position`, and settle which entry is primary when both name a side. On `horizontal-bar`, bind the bars to the axes the branch renders, draw `xAxis.title` on the category axis and the `yAxis` title under the number axis. One enumeration pin over the rows, each with the `bar` control.」 Rows checked: the card's four (lone `right` drawn left; `top`/`bottom` silent; second entry always right; `hasDualAxis` by count), the thread's two (`5834536782`: horizontal-bar two entries draws 4 bars; no-`series` first-entry `right` binds both derived series right, combo lone-right title on both sides), and objectui#10655's two (horizontal-bar never draws `xAxis.title`; `yAxis` title rotated beside the category ticks).

1. **The resolver, `placeYAxes`** — `normalizeChartSchema.ts:487-522`. Takes the first two entries; `openSlot` maps `left`/`right` to a slot on a chart whose value axes run up its side and `bottom`/`top` (as `left`/`right` slots) on `horizontal-bar` (:493-496); anything else is undefined and gets a `reason: 'side'` note (:512); both naming the same open side gives the first its side and the second the other with a `reason: 'taken'` note (:505, :514); an entry naming no side takes the free one (:506-508); neither naming one gives `left, right` (:508). RIGHT against the triage: sides honoured, other sides refused with a note naming `yAxis[N].position`, primary settled. The primary-entry rule (first keeps a contested side; the unnamed entry takes the free side) is the one declaration-order tie-break an author can read off the metadata, matches `yAxis[0]` already governing the horizontal grid (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` `showYGrid = primaryY?.showGridLines !== false`), and never maps a refused side to a "nearest" one. Note text (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:656-684`): a `side` note says which two sides are open and where the axis was drawn; a `taken` note says `yAxis[0]` already sits there and where this one was drawn; on horizontal-bar the sides read "at the bottom / at the top" via `valueAxisSide` (:606) and `onSide` (:612). RIGHT.

2. **Note channel reused, no second mechanism** — `yAxisPositionNotes` returns a `p role="note" data-chart-note="y-axis-position"` (:665), the exact shape of `xAxisPositionNote`'s `data-chart-note="x-axis-position"` (:586), and both go through the same `joinNotes(...)` into the same `ChartFootnote` on scatter (:2406), combo (:2529) and the plain branch (:2627). `null` when no note, which keeps every other chart's DOM unchanged. RIGHT (the x channel of PR objectui#10647 is the only mechanism).

3. **Lone `right` entry draws on the right** (card row 1) — plain branch single YAxis element gets `orientation: 'right'` when `soleYSlot === 'right'` (:2718) and its spec props measured for that slot (:1794, `axisValues` now takes every series on a one-axis chart, :1774); scatter's y axis the same (:2454); horizontal-bar's lone value axis takes `orientation: 'top'` (:2667). `hasDualAxis` is now "both slots filled" (:1720), so a lone `right` entry moves the axis and no longer implies a second one. RIGHT.

4. **`top` / `bottom` on a y entry no longer silent** (row 2) — refused with the note, placed as if unnamed (item 1). On horizontal-bar it is `left` / `right` that are refused (:493). RIGHT.

5. **Second entry no longer always the right axis** (row 3) — the left and right axis elements carry `leftY` / `rightY`, the entries `placeYAxes` put in each slot (:1714-1715), on the plain branch (:2700, :2709), combo (:2549-2550) and horizontal-bar (:2658-2659); tick formatters and value labels follow the slot (`leftYTickFormatter` / `rightYTickFormatter`, `axisOfSeries` :1727). RIGHT.

6. **Derived series bind to their own entry's slot** (thread row 2) — `normalizeChartSchema.ts:637-644`: the no-`series` branch calls the same `placeYAxes` and writes `yAxis: slot` for a right slot or any entry after the first (so an explicit `left` reaches an authored combo, which otherwise binds by index). Indices are the authored ones: the normaliser keeps every object entry with or without `field` (:311-333, :596-598), and the `field` filter runs after the slot is read by index. Entries past the second keep binding right, as before (disclosed in the PR body's acceptance notes; out of the card's rows). RIGHT.

7. **Combo lone `right` entry** (thread row 2, combo) — both combo axes now take the slot's entry or nothing (:2549-2550), so a lone right entry configures the right axis only and its title draws once. RIGHT.

8. **horizontal-bar two entries: bars bound to rendered axes** (thread row 1) — two value XAxis elements with `xAxisId="left"` (bottom) and `xAxisId="right"` (`orientation="top"`) (:2658-2659), and every mark in the plain branch binds `{ xAxisId: slot }` when horizontal, `{ yAxisId: slot }` otherwise, nothing when not dual (:2751; spread on Bar, Line and Area). At base the bars carried `yAxisId` while the branch rendered no YAxis with either id. RIGHT.

9. **horizontal-bar titles** (objectui#10655) — `xAxis.title` is drawn as the category YAxis element's `label`, laid out for an axis running down the plot on the side `placeXAxis` put it (`yAxisTitleLayoutFor(xAxisDown)`, :2683); the `yAxis` title takes the bottom x layout on the bottom value axis and the top x layout on the top one (:2658-2659, :2668). RIGHT: "draw `xAxis.title` on the category axis and the `yAxis` title under the number axis".

10. **JSDoc** — `yAxes` prop JSDoc (:322-327) no longer says a lone `position: 'right'` turns on the secondary axis; `NormalizedChartSchema.yAxes` (`normalizeChartSchema.ts:247-249`) no longer says index 0 is the left axis. Asked by the card's Direction. RIGHT.

11. **`hasNoNumericSeriesValue`** (:2997-3002) reads the same placement; with two entries the `left`/`right` entries are the placed ones and `dual` gates the `s.yAxis !== 'left'` term; with one entry every series counts against it. Still over-approximated toward silence. The existing noNumericValue tests use `[left, right]` entries, which place index-identically. RIGHT (consistency change the resolver requires). Minor: this helper places the full list on scatter while the render path slices to one entry (:1713); the difference can only add a declared scale, i.e. more silence, never a refusal.

12. **In-place fix (a): grid and annotations bound via `valueAxisIdFor`** (:641-645; grid :2542, :2644; annotations :1831, :1844, :1857). Judgment: PARTLY REQUIRED, remainder in-place. The new horizontal-bar dual branch renders two value XAxis elements with ids and none at id 0, so a CartesianGrid without `xAxisId` would have lost its vertical lines: the horizontal-bar row cannot land without this binding. Its extension to combo and two-entry bar/line/area (a `{ yAxisId: 'left' }` for a grid or an annotation bound to id 0 that those branches never render) is a visible change the card did not enumerate, same file, same class (a mark bound to an axis the branch does not render). Disclosed in the changeset ("Grid and annotations bind to the rendered left value axis…" and the user-visible sentence). Breaks no existing pin: no test at main reads grid-line counts on a dual-axis or combo chart (the only grid-count test is `scatterGridLines-9792`, and scatter's grid line :2414 is untouched); the reference-line/area tests in plugin-charts and plugin-dashboard assert only "greater than 0" or 0, and the new ids always name an axis the branch renders, so a count cannot drop. Pinned by row 11 with the one-entry `bar` control (test :384-410). Breaks no documented behaviour. Judged acceptable under the bounded exemption.

13. **In-place fix (b): right-hand title mirrored** — `Y_AXIS_RIGHT_TITLE_LAYOUT = { angle: 90, position: 'insideRight' }` (:517), chosen by `yAxisTitleLayoutFor` (:520) for the right slot (:1794). Judgment: NOT REQUIRED by any enumerated row (row 3's `onRight(title.x)` would already hold with the base `insideLeft` layout at x≈462 of 510), so it is a visible change the card did not ask for, and it moves the title of every existing second-entry axis on charts that never set `position`. It follows the shape of PR objectui#10647, which mirrored the top x title for the same reason (`X_AXIS_TOP_TITLE_LAYOUT`, :505). Disclosed in the changeset (own bullet, plus "the title of every right-hand value axis" in the user-visible sentence) and in the PR body. Breaks no existing pin: no test at main reads `insideLeft`, `insideRight`, an `angle`, or a right-hand title's geometry outside the two position pins. Breaks no documented behaviour: no docs sentence places a right-hand title. Pinned by row 10 with the left-axis `bar` control (test :355-371). Not a defect under the FAIL criteria; recorded as scope beyond the ask, disclosed.

14. **Missing asks** — none binding. Non-binding: objectui#10655's Direction said the docs `title` row "may need a sentence on which axis each title names on `horizontal-bar`"; the `title` row (mdx :236) is unchanged, while the `position` row already states that on `horizontal-bar` `xAxis` configures the category axis. Not a breach.

15. **Done but not asked** — items 12 (its non-horizontal-bar part) and 13 above; `axisValues` measuring every series on a one-axis chart whichever slot it sits in (:1774), which the lone-right axis needs for `stepSize`. Nothing else: no key, schema, export or accept set added.
